method: Preset 07 re-audit: preserve Kernel/Host authority, remove confirmed duplicate operational micro-guidance from always-visible prompt surfaces, and keep C01 as frozen historical evidence.

A_kernel_authority_kept.instruction: Stay inside the current Task/Work Contract.
Kernel executes or reuses trusted proof.
Independent judgment uses Kernel review receipts.
Stay inside workUnit.allowedPaths and out of forbiddenPaths.
Do not report success. Report what you changed and what should be verified.
Do not approve a change whose acceptance has no covering evidence.
Do not claim completion. Completion is decided by the Kernel from evidence.

B_common_stable_behavior_consolidated.instruction: Execute the current work unit within its declared scope and acceptance.
Use provided constraints, project context, relevant knowledge, and required evidence.
Make routine decisions autonomously; ask only for material ambiguity.
Reuse existing project structure and avoid unrequested abstractions or workflow.

C_duplicate_legacy_removed.instruction: Search with rg first and impose a fixed file-reading order.
C_duplicate_legacy_removed.remainingAuthority: Host/tool behavior and current task scope; search order is not workflow authority.

C_duplicate_legacy_removed.instruction: Use fixed 10-30 second waits, 1-3 second polls, and progress-bound polling rules.
C_duplicate_legacy_removed.remainingAuthority: Host process lifecycle and returned continuation state.

C_duplicate_legacy_removed.instruction: Read plans in a prescribed fast two-turn sequence and apply fixed context token budgets.
C_duplicate_legacy_removed.remainingAuthority: Task/Work Contract plus Kernel context materialization.

C_duplicate_legacy_removed.instruction: Repeat Kernel workflow/evidence/model ownership rules in the Codex runtime profile.
C_duplicate_legacy_removed.remainingAuthority: Kernel action/Task Contract, Host model policy, and canonical profile references.

D_provider_specific_moved.instruction: Keep thinking enabled; control cost through effort.
Use native tool calls only; do not execute tool-like text.
Effort selection per action and risk tier.
Model, reasoning effort, sandbox, and approval policy are execution authority, not prompt text.
Codex model routing and reasoning effort selection.

E_dynamic_moved_to_volatile_tail.movedTo: src/host/kernel/prompt-envelope.ts control (never rendered into a segment)
